**Unresolved conflicts / basis caveats:**

- Several records are excerpted mid-sentence; figures outside the excerpt are not inferred.

|---|---|---|---|

**Downside evidence:** GAAP gross margin −20.4 ppt sequentially and "down 27.5 ppts" YoY (42.5% → 15.0%) [REC-INTC-03-02]; GAAP operating margin (68.2)% vs (0.1)% [REC-INTC-03-02]; GAAP net loss $(16.6)B [REC-INTC-03-02]; $15.9B impairment/valuation-allowance and $2.8B restructuring charges [REC-INTC-03-01, REC-INTC-03-03, REC-INTC-03-04]; dividend suspended from Q4 2024 [REC-INTC-02-04]; prior-period weakness already present in Q2 (GAAP operating margin (15.3)%, net loss $(1.6)B) [REC-INTC-02-03].

- Cash-versus-non-cash split of the $15.9B charge block is only partially disclosed.
- Forward guidance (Q4 2024 revenue $13.3–14.3B; GAAP EPS $(0.24)) is unverified projection [REC-INTC-03-01].
